page.title: How one kid's pirate dream became One Piece
page.sub: The story of Eiichiro Oda, the creator of One Piece
page.bigIdea: Eiichiro Oda picked his dream at age 4 and never quit. Now One Piece has more than 600 million copies in print.

cards.title: He chose his dream at age 4
cards.front: Little Eiichiro decided he'd draw manga for a living.
cards.back: He loved Dragon Ball and a cartoon about Vikings, which got him hooked on pirates. He never changed his mind.
cards.tryit: Write down a dream you've had for years. What's one step toward it?

cards.title: His first big win came at 17
cards.front: At 17, he entered a manga contest and won second place.
cards.back: His story Wanted! placed second in the Tezuka Award, a famous prize for new artists. Two years later he won another award.
cards.tryit: Show something you made to someone, or enter it in a contest.

cards.title: He learned by helping others
cards.front: Before One Piece, Oda worked as an assistant.
cards.back: He helped other manga artists draw their series, including Rurouni Kenshin. He even helped design one of its characters.
cards.tryit: Find someone who's great at something and learn from them.

cards.title: One Piece began in 1997
cards.front: His pirate story started in a weekly magazine.
cards.back: Oda has drawn new chapters almost every week since 1997. That's nearly 30 years of the same adventure.
cards.tryit: Pick one habit you'll do every week, like drawing or practice.

cards.title: A Guinness World Record
cards.front: One Piece is the best-selling comic by a single author ever.
cards.back: It holds a Guinness World Record, with more than 600 million copies printed. It's now an anime, movies and a Netflix show.
cards.tryit: Think about it: one person's idea reached the whole world.

quiz.q: How old was Oda when he decided to become a manga artist?
quiz.why: He was just 4, and he stuck with that dream his whole life.

quiz.q: Which show got Oda interested in pirates?
quiz.hint: Think of sailors from long ago in Scandinavia.
quiz.why: Vicky the Viking made him love adventures at sea.

quiz.q: What did Oda do before starting One Piece?
quiz.why: Helping other artists taught him how the job really works.

quiz.q: About how many One Piece copies have been printed?
quiz.hint: It's the best-selling comic by one author ever.
quiz.why: More than 600 million. That's a Guinness World Record level.

page.think: Oda has worked on the same story for almost 30 years. What's something you love enough to keep doing for a really long time?
